full_page.content:
Page 231 Cont. Sep. 4 Boy 17 cripple from Aleganey Mts.
Page 232
Sep. 4 Patrick Mooney - 4 - never able to see - Except seemingly to dis- tinguish between light & darkness.
John Stafford - 17 - rhumatism
John Wilford Kennedy Jr. ( Jackie) 12 - lukemia .... Drs. seem to have no hope of recovery - only child -
5 Michael Mikowski - 42 - T.B. in Kiefer hesitating in fear of serious operation Drs. think colapse of lung, removal of ribs, etc. only hope ..... Enrolled 50¢
Ruth A. Brogan - 17 - of Lansing - quite nerveous - almost infantile Elaine McCurdy - 13 - infantile - five years ... & hopes to be cured Esther Oppo - 26 - earnestly prays for direction in "Colored" missions 520 Fernhill Ave.
Mrs. Rose Tancedo - 36 - peace in Fam.
Page 233 Sept. 11 Jerome Cusmano - 62 - sorosis of liver and bad stomach ....
Mrs. - Van Dyke - Thanks.
Mrs. Leona Padock - Thanks heart better.
Mrs Mary Hatt - 45 - tuomer removed from sholder this a.m .....
Mary Wend - over 70 - had breast removed six weeks ago Today, had asked for prayers here and Enrolled in Ser. Mass Ass'n has astonished her friends - is home near a month.
Miss San Pierre - 15 - away since 8th came home last night 12 a.m.
James Campbell - 50 - cancer on leg-bone feared. Had been feeling well and some months ago sneezed quite strongly and broke his leg a- bove the knee. Drs. figuered it was cancer probably two yrs ....
